title: Recover missing RabbitMQ worker consumer
trigger: RabbitMQ queue depth is increasing, worker throughput is zero, and consumer count is zero while broker and API remain healthy.
preconditions: confirm the incident is not a broker-wide outage
confirm synchronous API customer path remains available
capture worker and RabbitMQ evidence before changing runtime state
confirm no deployment or approved maintenance explains the consumer loss
diagnostic_steps: check RabbitMQ queue ready/unacked message counts
check RabbitMQ consumer count for nightwatch-jobs
check worker processing rate and failure metrics
inspect worker logs around the first observed timestamp
mitigation_steps: if evidence isolates the failure to a dead worker consumer and broker health is normal, restart the worker service only
do not restart PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, API, or Nginx without separate evidence
validation_steps: consumer count returns to expected value
no new worker error signal appears during the observation window
escalation_boundary: Escalate to application/L3 if the worker repeatedly exits, cannot reconnect after one approved restart, reports a code exception, or requires source/configuration changes outside the approved L2 runbook. Link recurring incidents to PRB-1001.
